# bestmodel

> bestmodel.run — the open compatibility engine for local AI. Answers "can it
> run / how fast / is it worth it?" for any model on any machine, from a
> signed, validated community measurement pool instead of static formulas.

Core principle: number honesty. Every displayed number declares its basis:
measured (pool median) > reported (1–2 runs) > extrapolated (bandwidth-scaled)
> formula > no data yet.

## Reader journeys (site)

- `?as=human` — cinematic tour (goal / hardware / mobile). Goal vs hardware
  is a second axis, only for humans.
- `?as=agent` — HTML contract: clone, honesty ladder, match API.
- If the site asked who is reading, it did not have enough signal to guess.
- Deployed twin of this file: `apps/web/site/llms.txt`

## CLI quickstart for agents (offline, from the clone)

```bash
cargo build --release -p canirunit -p benchmark-probe
./target/release/benchmark-probe --runtime mock --model qwen3:8b        # real hardware detection
./target/release/canirunit rigs --runs apps/web/data/derived/pool.json  # GPU ids the pool knows
./target/release/canirunit suggest --gpu rtx-3090-24gb --task decode_tok_s \
  --runs apps/web/data/derived/pool.json --gpus cli/canirunit/gpu_transfer_specs.json
./target/release/benchmark-probe lab --stub --trials 60                 # TPE flag search (SIM-marked)
```

One-command self-check after cloning: `make agent-smoke`. Pool suggestions
load as source_class=harvested (community medians); mock and lab-stub output
is SIMULATION, never a measurement claim. Full runbook with the honesty
rules: docs/agent-quickstart.md.

## Components

- apps/public-api: FastAPI — matching, submission intake, leaderboard
- apps/intake-worker: anti-fraud validation pipeline, trust scoring
- apps/web: the static site at bestmodel.run + frozen data snapshot pipeline
- apps/pool-backend: pool sync, plausibility curation, local match API
- packages/roofline-kernel: VRAM footprint + throughput prediction engine
- packages/domain-schema, runtime-probes, recommendation-engine, fake-adapters
- cli/benchmark-probe: Rust agent — hardware detection, standardized scenarios,
  Ed25519-signed reports
- cli/canirunit: `suggest`/`rigs` — deterministic best-model ranking per GPU
  from the runs corpus (no LLM in the path)
- cli/comfy-lab: ComfyUI probe/workflow analyzer/lab runner (diffusion vertical)

## API surface

- POST /v1/match/hardware-to-models — models for a machine
- POST /v1/match/model-to-hardware — machines for a model
- POST /v1/submissions (+ GET /v1/submissions/nonce) — signed benchmark intake
- GET /v1/leaderboard — ranked results with hardware/model/runtime/quant filters

## Auth (S13)

- POST /v1/auth/passkey/register/options + /verify — create account, add passkey (WebAuthn)
- POST /v1/auth/passkey/login/options + /verify — assert passkey, receive session bearer token
- POST/GET/DELETE /v1/auth/tokens — long-lived agent tokens (shown once, SHA-256 at rest)

## Social (S14)

- POST /v1/rigs · GET/PATCH /v1/rigs/{slug} · POST /v1/rigs/{slug}/bind — user rigs,
  optional binding to hardware_submission rows unlocks per-rig measured runs
- GET /v1/users/{handle} — profile: reputation tier/points, badges, visible rigs

## Claims (S15)

- POST /v1/claims — assert a run without proof; prior snapshot frozen at creation
  (pool medians + roofline range when GPU resolvable); never in leaderboards
- GET /v1/claims?status=open&sort=controversial|recent|strongest — feed inputs
- POST /v1/claims/{id}/votes — plausible/impossible; weight by reputation tier
  (L0=0.2 … L4=1.0), one vote per voter, claimant cannot self-vote
- POST /v1/claims/{id}/retract — claimant-only, open claims only

## Social graph & feed (S17)

- POST/DELETE /v1/users/{handle}/follow — follow graph (self/duplicate blocked);
  profile payloads carry follower/following counts + viewer perspective
- GET /v1/feed?scope=following|global&sort=recent|trending — typed items:
  claims with live tallies + account-attributed validated runs

## Cards, badges & limits (S18–S20)

- GET /v1/cards/claims/{id}.svg | .md — shareable claim cards (honesty-ladder prior line)
- GET /v1/badges/runs/{run_id}.svg — embeddable 'N tok/s on <gpu>' badge;
  validated runs only
- Rate limits scale with reputation tier: claims 2–50 per 24h, votes
  5–250 per hour (L0→L4); verified activity raises your ceiling
- Web console (apps/web/console): passkey sign-in → browse → vote → claim →
  settle command + card preview, zero dependencies

## Deployment (S21)

- Frontend: Vercel (apps/web, vercel.json rewrites /v1/* to the API)
- Backend: deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml on any Docker host (api, worker,
  postgres timescale+vector, redis); Caddy auto-TLS or Cloudflare tunnel
- Migration contract: named volumes + pg_dump scripts in deploy/scripts;
- Runbook: docs/en/deploy.md
- GET /v1/notifications + POST /v1/notifications/{id}/read — settlement and
  new-follower events land here

## Reported runs & transparency (L03 engine surface)

- POST /v1/contributors — lightweight contributor account (email + agent token, sha256 at rest)
- POST /v1/submissions/reported — reported (unsigned) run intake with per-IP
  quota backed by an auditable submission log; enters the ladder as `reported`
- GET /v1/transparency/sources — where every number class comes from
- GET /v1/leaderboard — now filtered by source_class/recipe_id; entries carry
  video metrics (seconds_per_clip, it_per_s, frames_per_s); a cell without a
  source class never renders
- POST /v1/submissions — also accepts comfyui video reports (recipe_id binding,
  source_class=measured_signed at intake)

## Known audio answer (2026-09-23 / this 3090)

Question: best local model to transcribe Portuguese on an RTX 3090 24GB.

The 2026-09-18 snapshot had **no** `rtx-3090-24gb` audio cell. The L4
Whisper Large v3 4.82×real cell is another GPU and has no language — do
not use it. This tree now appends Whisper Large v3 Turbo:
`audioXReal` **39.22** (n=3, measured, FLEURS `pt_br` speed window).
WER **0.04** (n=1, reported) lives on the card — the pool has no
language-quality field. Card:
[docs/measurements/2026-09-23-audio-pt-br-3090.md](docs/measurements/2026-09-23-audio-pt-br-3090.md).
Native leave-running bench (not built):
[specs/en/L07-native-audio-bench.md](specs/en/L07-native-audio-bench.md).
Live bestmodel.run stays on the frozen snapshot until this ships.
